svg.title: PyTorch multi-task model test results
svg.desc: Three panels show combined training and validation loss, actual versus predicted rental counts, and an empty-station confusion matrix. The selected checkpoint is epoch 49, rental mean absolute error is 3.11, and the confusion matrix contains 382 true negatives, 14 false positives, 31 false negatives, and 53 true positives.
